monkey_patch_inventory.lifecycle_profiler: No class/function/module monkey patch was found in frozen package source. It uses registration APIs and an optional observer-factory API.
kvcompress: conditional host compatibility shims for routed-expert output, DCP helper, Step3p5 linear alias, model routing flag, and Qwen GDN op ABI
monkey_patch_inventory.composition_result: None of the KVCompress targets is written by lifecycle_profiler at the frozen commit. Both may touch the same Scheduler process, but only KVCompress owns mutation; profiler observes host EventBus output.

cleanup_ownership.lifecycle_profiler: Owns and bounds its writer close through atexit; exposes sink-local unregister but the frozen host does not call that helper during EngineCore.shutdown. The remaining sink and process globals die with the process.
cleanup_ownership.kvcompress: Owns per-request pending/deferred block release and calibration forward-hook cleanup. Class/module patches and meta_path finder are process-lifetime and have no unpatch routine.
cleanup_ownership.host: Owns server, EngineCore, scheduler, executor, worker, distributed-state, and device-memory shutdown.
cleanup_ownership.condition: Admission assumes a normal fresh-process serve lifecycle; in-process unload/reload or hot disable without process replacement is outside this verdict.

admission_conditions: Use exactly the four frozen commits/trees and source blobs verified by verify-independent-oracle.py.
Activate both distinct entry points in every relevant process; do not let a replacement VLLM_PLUGINS value omit either name.
Keep KVCompress as the only extension claiming vllm-ascend.kv-cache.mutation and its listed scheduler/KV/runner patch seams.
Use valid, distinct profiler trace and KVCompress calibration/config paths; preserve host-owned shutdown.
Treat the campaign workload only as binding/lifecycle composition evidence because max_model_len 2048 cannot cross compression_threshold_tokens 9216.
Require both campaign installation orders to meet the frozen runtime evidence requirements before making a dynamic composition claim.
explicitly_unverified: No real Host 973d9ef5 / Ascend 873584026 service was launched by this independent static review.

Campaign health, completion, process-owned request_finished_observed receipt, KVCompress bind log, process identities, NPU quiescence, port closure, and both installation-order executions remain runtime evidence to be produced elsewhere.

The campaign workload cannot exercise a KV compression transaction or device mutation because max_model_len is below the configured threshold; compression correctness and cleanup after a real transaction remain unverified here.
Campaign wheel files and their declared SHA-256 values were not available as inputs to this source review; source commits/trees/blobs were verified instead.

The configured calibration artifact bytes, KVCompress config bytes, model weights, native Ascend operators, Triton runtime, Transformers/Accelerate packages, and Extension Manager stored configuration were not independently audited.

No composition guarantee is made for a third plugin, in-process hot unload/reload, a different host/Ascend commit, KV transfer, model-native compression, unsupported runner type, or a changed method signature.

Profiler optional KV-recovery observer-factory integration is unavailable in frozen Host 973d9ef5 because vllm/v1/kv_recovery_profile.py is absent; the code catches that optional registration failure. Base EventBus lifecycle profiling remains the reviewed surface.
